intro: Camping 101: Tailoring points skilled clothworkers toward Eldrin at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. Through him, tailors learn to weave a Faction Banner that provides inspiration and raises morale at backcountry campsites.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
